# Contingency budgets (to come)

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
This chapter is planned and not yet written.
:::

Cambridge voters turned down the proposed 2026–27 budget in May 2026 and again in a June revote (see [The property-tax cap](tax-cap.qmd)). When that happens, a district must operate on a contingency budget set by state rules. This chapter will explain what those rules are, how often New York districts end up on a contingency budget, and what it means for Cambridge.
